shadows.name: text-glow

components.name: CV Button
components.description: Solid phosphor call to action with ink-on-glow label.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:52px;padding-inline:22px;font-family:'Silkscreen','Courier New',monospace;font-weight:600;font-size:.9375rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:var(--on-ph,#0a1205);background:var(--p1,#c3f23b);border:2px solid var(--p5,#e9ffa8);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgb(195 242 59/.35);transition:transform .2s steps(3),box-shadow .2s steps(3)}.ds-btn:hover{transform:translate(-2px,-2px);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgb(195 242 59/.5)}.ds-btn:active{transform:translate(3px,3px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px dashed var(--p5,#e9ffa8);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Tape Menu Bar
components.description: Floating bottom nav with a solid active block.
components.html: RCPerfilProyectosContacto
components.css: .ds-pill{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:5px;background:var(--panel,#0d1608);border:2px solid var(--p3,#86bb2d);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgb(195 242 59/.18);font-family:'VT323','Courier New',monospace}.ds-pill a{min-height:40px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;padding-inline:12px;font-size:1.3125rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted,#7fa83a);text-decoration:none}.ds-pill a:hover{color:var(--p1,#c3f23b)}.ds-pill a[aria-current]{background:var(--p3,#86bb2d);color:var(--on-ph,#0a1205)}.ds-pill a:focus-visible{outline:3px dashed var(--p5,#e9ffa8);outline-offset:4px}.ds-brand{font-family:'Silkscreen',monospace;font-size:.9375rem;padding-inline:10px;color:var(--p1,#c3f23b)}

components.name: Inline Link
components.description: Dotted underline that turns solid and brightens on hover.

components.name: Timeline Row with Live Badge
components.description: Dashed-rule row with a blinking en-curso badge.
components.css: .ds-rows{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:2px dashed rgb(127 168 58/.35);font-family:'VT323',monospace;font-size:1.375rem;color:var(--text,#bfe83a)}.ds-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding-block:18px;border-bottom:2px dashed rgb(127 168 58/.35)}.ds-row h3{margin:0;font-family:'Silkscreen',monospace;font-weight:600;font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.3;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-org{margin:.25rem 0 0;color:var(--muted,#7fa83a)}.ds-live{margin:0;display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--on-ph,#0a1205);background:var(--p1,#c3f23b);animation:ds-blink 1.4s steps(2) infinite}@keyframes ds-blink{50%{opacity:0}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-live{animation:none}}

components.name: OSD Play and Volume
components.description: Tape OSD: CSS-drawn play mark and a ten-block volume meter.

components.name: Packet Slab
components.description: One dot-matrix layer of the packet with ruler and band label.
components.css: .ds-slab{--c:var(--p3,#86bb2d);position:relative;width:300px;height:190px;background:var(--panel,#0d1608);border:2px solid var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 30px color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 30%,transparent),inset 0 0 0 4px var(--panel,#0d1608),inset 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 55%,transparent);overflow:hidden}.ds-slab::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.32;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,var(--c) 0 3px,transparent 3.6px);background-size:10px 10px}.ds-ruler{position:absolute;top:6px;left:10px;right:10px;height:6px;opacity:.7;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:calc(100%/32) 100%}.ds-band{position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:6px;font-family:'VT323',monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c)}

components.name: Sent Stamp
components.description: Rotated dashed-border ENVIADO stamp with timestamp.

narrative.overview: The whole page is the screen of a green-phosphor CRT fed by a VHS deck. One hue carries everything; hierarchy is brightness and halftone dot density, never a second color. A single dot-matrix packet sits in a fixed stage and gains one slab per section, one per TCP/IP layer (Aplicacion, Transporte, Red, Enlace, Fisica), brightening as it lands. Scroll is the cable: Lenis smoothing writes progress into CSS custom properties and everything on the stage reads them.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome phosphor green on near-black olive; five brightness steps stand in for five layers.
Pixel faces only: Silkscreen for display, VT323 for everything else.
Hard square corners on all UI; the only large curve is the monitor bezel.
Glow and scanlines are the depth system; there are no soft drop shadows.
Entry is a ritual: PLAY gate (when autoplay is blocked), then a randomized 4 s VHS insert-tape loader.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: No second accent color. Importance is a brighter step or a denser dot pattern. The only off-hue color is the faint magenta/cyan text fringe, which is a lens artifact, not a palette member.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Glow Rule
rules.body: Solid phosphor fills always take on-phosphor text with text-shadow removed.

rules.name: The Pixel Face Rule
rules.body: Only Silkscreen and VT323. Font smoothing is turned off so edges stay crisp.

rules.name: The Glow Rule
rules.body: Body text carries a three-part text-shadow (red fringe, cyan fringe, 8px green glow). Headings add a stepped offset shadow whose horizontal split scales with scroll speed. Text on solid fills drops it.

rules.name: The Emits-Light Rule
rules.body: Elevation means luminance. Raise importance by brightening and haloing, not by adding gray shadow.

dos: Do express hierarchy with the five phosphor steps and halftone density; the brightest step marks the final layer and focus.
Do put on-phosphor (#0a1205) text on every solid phosphor fill.
Do keep all corners square (0 radius) except the bezel.
Do use the dashed 3px phosphor-5 focus ring (4px offset) on every interactive element.
Do use steps() easing for any glitch, tape, press or stamp motion.
Do draw controls (play, pause, meters) in CSS shapes; keep Silkscreen and VT323 as the only faces.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling every looped or launched animation.
donts: Don't add a second hue or a gray; step brightness instead.
Don't use soft gray drop shadows, rounded cards, or gradients as decoration; depth is glow, scanline and vignette.
Don't use system or serif faces, or icon fonts and emoji glyphs.
Don't let section copy sit on the stage side; text stays in the left column (full width, beneath the packet window, at 820px and below).
Don't drop the five-layer packet structure or the VHS/CRT skin; they are binding commitments.
